title: 90 #### 5.2 Juvenile delinquency under local & special laws. A total of 82,893 offences involving juveniles were recorded in 1980 under the Local & Special Laws registering a decline of 1.4 percent over 1979. The largest contribution to the total was from offences under the Prohibition Act (29,419) and Gambling Act (18,423). The offences under Arms Act, Opium Act, Gambling Act, Prohibition Act, Motor Vehicles Act and Prevention of Corruption Act recorded an increase in 1980 over 1979 while the offences under Indian Railwas Act, Explosives and Explosive Substances Act, Excise Act, Suppression of Immoral Traffic Act and Miscellaneous Acts registered a decline during 1980 over 1979. Offences under 'Gambling Act' and 'Prohibition Act' accounted for about 57.7% of the total offences under Local & Special Laws. Table 32 presents the relevant statistics.
